Vendored third-party browser modules, copied from the published npm tarballs
(registry.npmjs.org); nothing is fetched at runtime. One local change:
preact/hooks.module.js imports "./preact.module.js" instead of the bare
specifier "preact", because the page's CSP forbids an inline import map.
Update by downloading the tarball, copying the same files and refreshing the
checksums below.
